(function() {
    var mod = {}
    var name = 'PCB Price Calculator'
    mod.area = 0

    var init = function() {
        mod.rate_area.value = '2.0'     // Set your default Rate here
        mod.setup.value = '50'          // Set your default Base Fee here
        mod.rate_time.value = '300'     // Set your default Hourly Rate here (₹/hour)
        mod.time_minutes.value = '0'    // Estimated time in minutes
        mod.quantity.value = '1'        // Number of PCBs
    }

    var update_side = function() {
        if (mod.single.checked) {
            mod.rate_area.value = '2.0'
        } else if (mod.double.checked) {
            mod.rate_area.value = '3.5'
        }
        update_price()
    }

    var update_price = function() {
        var rA = parseFloat(mod.rate_area.value) || 0
        var s = parseFloat(mod.setup.value) || 0
        var rT = parseFloat(mod.rate_time.value) || 0
        var t = parseFloat(mod.time_minutes.value) || 0
        var qty = parseFloat(mod.quantity.value) || 1
        
        // Calculate time cost (convert minutes to hours)
        var timeCost = (t / 60) * rT
        
        // Total per unit: Area cost + Base Fee + Time cost
        var perUnit = (mod.area * rA) + s + timeCost
        var total = perUnit * qty
        
        // Apply rounding if checkbox is checked
        if (mod.roundoff && mod.roundoff.checked) {
            perUnit = Math.round(perUnit)
            total = Math.round(total)
        }
        
        var decimals = mod.roundoff && mod.roundoff.checked ? 0 : 2
        mod.display_area.nodeValue = 'Area: ' + mod.area.toFixed(2) + ' cm²'
        mod.display_time.nodeValue = 'Time: ' + t.toFixed(0) + ' min (' + (t/60).toFixed(2) + ' hrs)'
        mod.display_quantity.nodeValue = 'Quantity: ' + qty
        mod.display_perunit.nodeValue = 'Per Unit: ₹' + perUnit.toFixed(decimals)
        mod.display_price.nodeValue = 'Total Price: ₹' + total.toFixed(decimals)
        mods.fit(mod.div) 
    }

    var inputs = {
        imageInfo: {
            type: 'object',
            event: function(evt) {
                var dpi = evt.detail.dpi
                var w = (evt.detail.width / dpi) * 2.54
                var h = (evt.detail.height / dpi) * 2.54
                mod.area = w * h
                update_price()
            }
        }
    }

    var interface = function(div) {
        mod.div = div
        div.style.textAlign = 'left'
        div.style.padding = '10px'
        div.style.minWidth = '160px'
        
        var createInput = function(label) {
            div.appendChild(document.createTextNode(label))
            var i = document.createElement('input')
            i.type = 'text'; i.size = 4; i.style.margin = '3px'
            i.addEventListener('input', update_price)
            div.appendChild(i)
            div.appendChild(document.createElement('br'))
            return i
        }

        // PCB Side Selection (creates hidden input for rate_area)
        mod.rate_area = document.createElement('input')
        mod.rate_area.type = 'hidden'
        mod.rate_area.value = '2.0'
        div.appendChild(mod.rate_area)
        
        div.appendChild(document.createTextNode('PCB Type: '))
        div.appendChild(document.createElement('br'))
        var single = document.createElement('input')
        single.type = 'radio'
        single.name = 'pcb_side'
        single.id = 'single'
        single.checked = true
        single.addEventListener('change', update_side)
        div.appendChild(single)
        div.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' Single (₹2/cm²)'))
        div.appendChild(document.createElement('br'))
        mod.single = single
        
        var double = document.createElement('input')
        double.type = 'radio'
        double.name = 'pcb_side'
        double.id = 'double'
        double.addEventListener('change', update_side)
        div.appendChild(double)
        div.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' Double (₹3.5/cm²)'))
        mod.double = double
        div.appendChild(document.createElement('br'))

        mod.setup = createInput('Base Fee (₹): ')
        mod.rate_time = createInput('Hourly Rate (₹/hr): ')
        mod.time_minutes = createInput('Time (minutes): ')
        mod.quantity = createInput('Number of PCBs: ')
        
        div.appendChild(document.createElement('br'))
        var checkbox = document.createElement('input')
        checkbox.type = 'checkbox'
        checkbox.id = 'roundoff'
        checkbox.checked = true
        checkbox.addEventListener('change', update_price)
        div.appendChild(checkbox)
        div.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' Round off to nearest ₹'))
        mod.roundoff = checkbox
        
        div.appendChild(document.createElement('hr'))
        
        var areaDiv = document.createElement('div')
        mod.display_area = document.createTextNode('Area: --')
        areaDiv.appendChild(mod.display_area); div.appendChild(areaDiv)
        
        var timeDiv = document.createElement('div')
        mod.display_time = document.createTextNode('Time: --')
        timeDiv.appendChild(mod.display_time); div.appendChild(timeDiv)
        
        var qtyDiv = document.createElement('div')
        mod.display_quantity = document.createTextNode('Quantity: 1')
        qtyDiv.appendChild(mod.display_quantity); div.appendChild(qtyDiv)
        
        var perunitDiv = document.createElement('div')
        mod.display_perunit = document.createTextNode('Per Unit: ₹0.00')
        perunitDiv.appendChild(mod.display_perunit); div.appendChild(perunitDiv)
        
        var priceDiv = document.createElement('div')
        priceDiv.style.fontSize = '1.3em'; priceDiv.style.color = '#1b5e20'; priceDiv.style.fontWeight = 'bold'
        mod.display_price = document.createTextNode('Total Price: ₹0.00')
        priceDiv.appendChild(mod.display_price); div.appendChild(priceDiv)
    }

    return {
        mod: mod,
        name: name,
        init: init,
        inputs: inputs,
        outputs: {},
        interface: interface
    }
}())
